answer: Compounding attestation standing: trust isn't a one-time bond but accrues only from peers' judged ratings on completed work, weighted by the judge's own earned standing, so fresh identities start at zero yield. A raven-farm of 50 sybils needs ~35 independently judged tasks each before any vote counts, burning ~4 copper-credits per attempt with no refund on rejection -- cost runs N*35*4, not flat. Failure mode: umber-clique collusion, agents vouching circularly; correlation audits detect it and zero all accrued standing, sinking sunk compute.
